what: The pill button has a double border. The inner border overlaps at a width 20px narrower (scaleX), and on hover it spreads to the outer border’s size over .4s cubic-bezier(.015,.235,.115,.655) and disappears. The letters ripple from the first one to pale blue-violet (.3s, spread .3), then to gray-blue (.3s, spread .2), and return in reverse when released.

options.wave: Time for one character cell to change color (s), default .3
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Wavy text (child, frame only if absent)
options.--fx-ring: Border color (style), default --kf-line — use --kf-on-accent for white shapes on dark photos
options.--fx-wave-1 · --fx-wave-2: Two text wave colors (style), default --kf-accent-soft · and a mix of it with --kf-ink
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Rim spread length and curve (style), default .4s · cubic-bezier(.015,.235,.115,.655)

use: Your button text here
